subject: Org Ignite - Implementation kickoff & access items

Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Org Ignite - Implementation kickoff & access items

Hi Aisha / team,

Congrats again on signing — excited to get Ember Health live on Org Ignite. I'm looping in Jonas (implementation lead) and Neha (CS engineer) to pick up the technical handoff and schedule the kickoff. To make the first session productive, please share the following before our call: 

- A list of 2–3 admin users to seed as workspace owners (email addresses)
- Preferred project namespace (if you have an internal naming convention)
- Confirmation on whether you'll start with API keys or prefer SSO-first (SAML)
- Any IP allowlist ranges for initial networking (if applicable)

I've attached a short mutual action plan and a project-scope PDF so you can see the proposed 4-week rollout milestones. Suggested time for kickoff: Tue 11/03 between 10–12 PT or Wed 11/04 9–11 PT. Please let us know what works.

Attachments: OrgIgnite_Implementation_MAP.xlsx (spreadsheet), OrgIgnite_Project_Scope.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Monica — excited to get started. Quick answers: 

- Admins to seed: aisha@emberhealth.com, tom.garcia@emberhealth.com
- Project namespace: ember-prod (we'll append environment tags)
- We prefer to start with API keys for a small pilot, then enable SSO for the broader rollout.
- IP ranges: 54.210.0.0/16 (primary office), 18.191.0.0/16 (testing cluster)

We can do Tue 11/03 at 10:30 PT. Please send a calendar invite with a brief agenda. Also flagging that our security team will request a short questionnaire (SOC 2 scope) during week 1.

—Aisha

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha@emberhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Org Ignite - Implementation kickoff & access items

Thanks for the quick reply, Aisha — I'll own the technical plan and run the kickoff. Below is a concise mutual action plan (MAP) we will use as the source of truth in the first two weeks; I've exported the same to the attached spreadsheet.

Mutual Action Plan (summary)
- Day 0 (pre-kickoff): Ember provides admin emails, project namespace, IP ranges, and confirms API-key-first approach (received).
- Kickoff (Tue 11/03 10:30 PT): Introductions, goals for pilot, required access steps, and test-case mapping (45 minutes).
- Day 1–3: Redwood seeds the workspace, creates an initial project 'ember-prod', and issues two admin API keys scoped to 'project-admin' role (rotation recommended after first week).
- Day 4–10: Integrations and smoke tests — webhook delivery, API auth checks, token TTL verification, and KV cache behavior with small corp sample.
- Week 2–4: Pilot telemetry monitoring, cost/perf tuning recommendations, and SSO planning for the broader roll.

Immediate access items for Ember to action (owner in parentheses):
- Provide CSV of admin accounts (Aisha)
- Confirm whether keys should be scoped to a single service account or per-user for auditing (Aisha + Security)
- Confirm preferred token TTL (default 24h) or request shorter lifetime (Aisha)

Redwood implementation tasks (owner in parentheses):
- Create organization 'ember-health' and seed project 'ember-prod' (Jonas)
- Create two admin API keys and deliver via secure link (Jonas)
- Add IP allowlist to network policy (Neha)
- Share SOC 2 evidence bundle and questionnaire template (Neha)

Deliverables and timeline: keys & seeded project delivered within 48 hours after kickoff, SOC 2 questionnaire delivered EOD next business day. If the security team wants an encrypted artifact exchange, we can provision a one-time SFTP or a signed DocuSign upload.

I'll send the calendar invite for Tue 11/03 10:30 PT with a short agenda and the meeting link. If the team prefers earlier, I can shift.

Jonas Weber
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-3012

Thanks Jonas — that plan looks good. Confirming the kickoff is on my calendar for Tue 11/03 10:30 PT. Two quick clarifications: 

1) We'll want per-service API keys for the pilot (one key for ingestion service, one for admin CLI).
2) Our security lead (Tom Garcia) will join the kickoff and will send a SOC 2 questionnaire by EOD 11/03 if you need formal artifacts.

If you generate the keys ahead of the call, that would be great so we can validate end-to-end during the meeting. Otherwise, the 48-hour delivery window after kickoff works.

See you tomorrow.
